# Intake rota: what changes in November

The intake rota moves from weekly to fortnightly in November. Weekly hand-offs lost more context than they saved: every hand-off restarted the open cases from the summary sheet. Fortnightly hand-offs with a fifteen-minute overlap call keep each case with one owner long enough to close it.

The summary sheet stays, but it is written at the end of a rota rather than the start.
